description: Service levels (SLA4OAI) across the catalog. Uptime a provider promises on its SLA page and reports on its status page, kept separate, quoted from its own pages. APIs.io runs no monitors, so nothing is measured or verified. method "generated" marks a synthetic base with no uptime figure, which is not a statement by the provider. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline each artifact's body instead of just its URL.

method.description: Who wrote the file: "searched" (quoted from the provider's pages) or "generated" (synthetic base, no uptime figure).

q.description: Free text over name + description, e.g. "sms".

sort.description: Order: relevance (catalog order), provider, or name.

tags.description: Tag slugs, e.g. ["payments"]. On providers: what the company does (see api_tags).

name: find_sla
